title: Precision Locksmith: Canary resilience harness and version lockflow for quantized models
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a resilient onboarding and pinning flow for quantization artifacts (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) that couples lightweight canaries, stability probes, and an automated rollback/lock mechanism. This ticket defines the end-to-end harness: artifact ingestion -> quick smoke profiling -> staged canary rollout (shadow + traffic-slice) -> pin registry update and emergency lock if regressions exceed thresholds. The focus is reducing noisy false positives while ensuring we catch small but customer-visible perf/quality regressions (latency P95, token-level accuracy on golden prompts, generation divergence).
acceptance_criteria: Ingestion pipeline accepts quant artifacts and produces a standardized artifact metadata record with fingerprint and supported precision tags
Smoke profiler runs within 2 minutes per artifact for representative prompt set and emits P50/P95 latency, token-error-rate, and perplexity deltas
Canary harness can deploy a model variant to 0.5%, 2%, and 10% traffic slices with automated metric comparison windows
Regression detector calculates rolling A/B delta for latency and quality metrics and triggers locked pin state if any metric exceeds configured thresholds
Pin registry supports a single-call promote/lock endpoint and immutable pin history for auditing
Dashboard shows per-artifact canary timeline, metric deltas, and links to associated PRs/changes
End-to-end test simulating a known bad INT8 artifact produces a rollback and an annotated incident that includes telemetry snapshots
tasks: Define artifact metadata schema (fingerprint, precision, kernel-hints, expected perf range)
Extend ingestion lambda to validate AWQ/GPTQ metadata and store canonical fingerprints
Implement fast smoke profiler harness that samples 50 golden prompts across typical seq-lens
Create canary orchestration flow in runtime to route traffic slices and collect per-slice metrics
Build regression detector service with configurable metric contracts and reversal policy
Expose promote/lock endpoints in pin registry and add audit logging
Add console widgets for canary timelines and an investigate button linking to telemetry
Write end-to-end integration test and a deliberate-failure test feeding a degraded INT8 artifact
Document runbook for SRE and SEs describing manual override and emergency unlock steps
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Ingest artifact and run smoke profiler (no traffic)
Phase 1: Shadow traffic for 1 hour, collect metrics and compare to baseline
Phase 2: 0.5% traffic slice for 6 hours with metric guardrails
Phase 3: 2% traffic slice for 24 hours if Phase 2 passes
Phase 4: 10% traffic slice for 48 hours, then promote to pin registry
Emergency: If any guardrail trips at any phase, automatically revert routing and place artifact into 'locked' state with reason
Manual override available to SRE with two-person approval and documented justification
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives from small sample sizes in smoke profiler -> Mitigation: use stratified golden prompts and increase sample size adaptively
Risk: Canary noise due to bursty traffic -> Mitigation: use time-windowed aggregation and baseline normalization by sequence-length buckets
Risk: Latency regressions acceptable for throughput-heavy customers -> Mitigation: annotate pins with customer tier and support selective routing policies
Risk: Artifact poisoning (malformed kernels) -> Mitigation: validate kernel hints and sandbox execution for first-run
Risk: Rollback flaps due to intermittent infra issues -> Mitigation: require consecutive-failure windows before locking and provide manual review path
